parts.title: Make governance repeatable
parts.body: ISO/IEC 42001 describes an AI management system: scope, leadership, policy, objectives, risk treatment, operations, performance review, and improvement. A useful implementation has an AI inventory, named owners, documented controls, evidence, and a review cadence. Certification, if pursued, is a separate decision; the standard itself does not guarantee a system is safe.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Build a control record
parts.body: Choose an internal support chatbot. Record owner, intended use, excluded uses, data sources, model supplier, evaluation results, review date, and incidents. If the owner changes or a new connector is added, specify who updates the record and what must be retested.
